description: OpenAI's Europe (EEA and Switzerland) regional storage and processing offer, served through the EU API domain for eligible models and endpoints.
residency_notes: EU regional storage and processing require OpenAI eligibility, an approved retention control, and a Modified Retention amendment. Use an EU project or the EU-prefixed domain with an eligible Global project; endpoint and model eligibility still apply. System data and content sent to third-party tools are outside the residency guarantee.
prompt_training_notes: OpenAI says API and other business data is not used to train or improve its models by default.
user_identifier_notes: Phaseo may send this provider a provider-facing pseudonymous user identifier when the upstream API supports it.
regional_pricing_notes: OpenAI charges data-residency endpoints a 10% uplift for eligible models released on or after March 5, 2026.

sources.notes: EU domain, regional storage and processing, eligibility requirements, supported endpoints and model snapshots, and endpoint limitations.
Regional processing uplift for eligible models released on or after March 5, 2026.

verification.notes: Verified as a regional OpenAI direct offer using the shared API contract and credentials with the required eu.api.openai.com domain.
